pricing_free_tier: free, open source (MIT); exchange trading fees apply
rate_limits: set by each exchange (ccxt's built-in rate limiter)

name: LumiBot
assets_covered: stocks; ETFs; options; futures; forex; crypto; prediction markets
live_vs_paper: backtest, paper and live (self-hosted); the strategy class can stay the same, but startup code must call Strategy.backtest() for history or run_live()/Trader.run_all() for a broker. Alpaca paper is PAPER true or ALPACA_IS_PAPER, and the CLI has lumibot run --paper. Alpaca, Tradier, Interactive Brokers and Tradovate document paper or demo accounts; CCXT can use sandbox true where the exchange has a testnet. Setting IS_BACKTESTING=false does not by itself turn a backtest-only file into broker trading.
order_approval_safety: open-source (GPL-3.0) Python framework. AI strategies can set research agents to allow_trading=False and let one agent with allow_trading=True submit orders through the same order pipeline as a Python strategy. No per-order human confirmation is documented in the library. Named brokers: Alpaca, Interactive Brokers, Tradier, Charles Schwab, Tradovate, TopstepX via ProjectX, Bitunix and Polymarket, and MetaMask Agent Wallet (beta, from package 4.6.44: Hyperliquid perps and spot swaps, keys held by MetaMask, limits and expiry set through MetaMask authorization and Guard Mode; LumiBot says the adapter is qualified on testnet only and claims no mainnet trading qualification), plus crypto exchanges through CCXT (the broker page says nine direct integrations, and the installed CCXT version lists 100+ exchange ids; the agent docs say LumiBot does not claim every CCXT exchange). 2,164 GitHub stars on Oct 24, 2026. Free skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor: https://github.com/Lumiwealth/lumibot-trading-skills (MIT).
pricing_free_tier: free, open source (GPL-3.0). You pay broker commissions, any market-data plan, and AI model calls if you use agents.

name: Vibe-Trading

Most of its 19 broker connectors also place orders on the broker's own paper account; bounded live orders are wired for Alpaca, Binance, OKX, Futu, Tiger, eToro, MetaTrader 5 and Robinhood (Robinhood is live-only). Paper vs live is a per-broker runtime check (account id, host, demo flag), not a setting the agent can flip, and brokers without such a signal are capped at paper and read-only.
order_approval_safety: open-source (MIT) Python trading agent from the Data Intelligence Lab at HKU (GitHub org HKUDS), with CLI, Web UI and an MCP server. Live orders need a mandate you commit (symbols, order size, exposure, leverage, daily cap) and run inside it with no per-order human confirmation; there is a kill switch (/halt) that cancels and flattens, mandate auto-expiry and an append-only audit ledger. IBKR, Scalable Capital, Trading 212 and Toss Securities connectors are read-only. It holds no funds: the broker holds the money and executes. 36,701 GitHub stars on Oct 26, 2026. The maker warns that the X account VibeTrading_HKU and any Vibe-Trading token or memecoin are not official; it has never launched a token.
pricing_free_tier: free, open source (MIT); pip install vibe-trading-ai. You pay your LLM provider plus any broker or data costs.

name: Mangrove
assets_covered: crypto spot and whole-share US equities on Robinhood (long-only, limit orders); DEX swaps through 1inch on 10 EVM chains; Kraken (orders through Mangrove's keyless OAuth connection)
live_vs_paper: paper schedules run on MangroveAI with no funds at risk; live execution on Robinhood, 1inch DEX swaps and Kraken OAuth

pricing_free_tier: free MangroveAI API key, or pay per call in USDC with x402 (default local spend cap $25, $1 per payment); Markets read tools $0.01 each; developer API Pro plan $29.99/month (billed separately from the app plan: 1,200 API calls, 500 backtests and 500k tokens a month, 14-day trial)

name: Nyria

assets_covered: US-listed stocks; ETFs (long only; no crypto, options, forex or CFDs)

name: tread.fi
assets_covered: crypto spot; crypto perpetuals (CEX and perp DEX); prediction markets (Polymarket, Kalshi, Hyperliquid HIP-4)
live_vs_paper: live trading on your own connected exchange accounts and wallets; pre-trade analytics before you start a bot or algo order
